title.zh: A whitehat hacker is holding $320 million in drained Bitcoin until developers prove they patched a fatal network flaw
title.en: A whitehat hacker is holding $320 million in drained Bitcoin until developers prove they patched a fatal network flaw

current_state.zh: A whitehat hacker drained ~$320M in Bitcoin from Liquid Network's federation reserve via a bug in SideSwap's peg-out process and is holding it until developers prove the underlying network flaw is patched.
